  html_document:

    toc_float: true
    number_sections: true

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(stringr)

# ==========================================================

# Load metadata

# ==========================================================

meta <- read_csv("/media/jwchoi/ssd2/projects/microbiome/16S_1/metadata/scalp_16s_o.csv")

# ==========================================================

# Apply filtering

# Conditions: Seq == "16S" & Site == "Scalp" & Dx=="CTRL" & Time_points=="t=1 (Day 0)"

# ==========================================================

filtered <- meta %>%
filter(
Seq == "16S",
Site == "Scalp",
Dx == "CTRL",
Time_points == "t=1 (Day 0)"
)

cat("✅ Number of rows after filtering:", nrow(filtered), "\n")

# ==========================================================

# 1. Count of distinct BioProjects

# ==========================================================

n_bioproject <- filtered %>%
distinct(BioProject) %>%
nrow()
cat("1️⃣ Number of distinct BioProjects (filtered):", n_bioproject, "\n")

# ==========================================================

# 2. Count of distinct subjects per BioProject

# Normalize Subject_id (remove trailing '_i' etc.)

# ==========================================================

filtered <- filtered %>%
mutate(Subject_core = str_replace(Subject_id, "_.*$", ""))

subject_summary <- filtered %>%
group_by(BioProject) %>%
summarise(
Subject_ids = list(unique(Subject_core)),
n_unique_subjects = length(unique(Subject_core)),
.groups = "drop"
)

cat("2️⃣ Subject count per BioProject (distinct normalized Subject_id):\n")
subject_summary

# ==========================================================

# 3. Total unique subjects across all BioProjects

# ==========================================================

total_unique_subjects <- length(unique(filtered$Subject_core))
cat("\n✅ Total unique subjects across all filtered BioProjects:", total_unique_subjects, "\n")

# ==========================================================

# 4. BioProject-wise metadata availability

# ==========================================================

bioproject_summary <- filtered %>%
group_by(BioProject) %>%
summarise(
Metadata_Sex  = if_else(any(Sex != "NS" & !is.na(Sex)), "Yes", "No"),
Metadata_Age  = if_else(any(Age != "NS" & !is.na(Age)), "Yes", "No"),
Metadata_Race = if_else(any(Ethnicity != "NS" & !is.na(Ethnicity)), "Yes", "No"),
Sample_numbers  = n(),
Subject_numbers = n_distinct(Subject_core),
Layout      = paste(unique(Layout), collapse = ", "),
Sample_type = paste(sort(unique(Sample)), collapse = ", "),
.groups = "drop"
) %>%
ungroup()

cat("3️⃣ BioProject-wise summary:\n")
bioproject_summary

# ==========================================================

# 5. Save summary table

# ==========================================================

write_csv(
bioproject_summary,
"/media/jwchoi/ssd2/projects/microbiome/16S_1/metadata/table_1_bioproject_summary_filtered.csv"
)
